name: The Freddie Freeloader Project + Nuno Sá
description: The Freddie Freeloader Project performs live at Era uma vez em Paris, followed by a DJ set from Nuno Sá.
longDescription:
Era uma vez em Paris hosts an evening featuring The Freddie Freeloader Project and Nuno Sá on 20 November 2026. The venue is located at Rua da Galeria de Paris, 106.

The night begins with a live concert by The Freddie Freeloader Project at 22:00. A DJ set from Nuno Sá follows starting at 23:30. The event is open to attendees aged 18 and over.
